new_value: Judged: the second prune is load-bearing, not waste - documented rather than removed. In select_parent() the chosen parent may lower lowest_rank, which tightens the MaxRankIncrease bound (cost <= lowest_rank + max_rank_increase); parents admissible under the previous lowest_rank can violate it. A precise comment now explains this before the re-prune call. New test selecting_better_parent_reprunes_against_new_max_rank_bound proves necessity: parents A(cost 1024)/B(cost 1792)/C(cost 512), lowest_rank drops 1024->512 on selecting C, tightening the bound to 1536 so B is pruned by the second pass only (final count 2, B gone). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-rpl --lib 139 passed.
